image_description: A low-angle, high-contrast shot of a band performing on a stage. The subjects are silhouetted against bright, hazy stage lighting (yellow, orange, blue). In the foreground, there is a wooden ramp or walkway leading up to the main platform. Several figures (musicians) stand on the stage, including one with an arm raised. Stage equipment like monitors and microphone stands are visible in silhouette.

The edge of the stage is defined by the contrast between the lit haze behind the figures and the dark foreground/ramp. The physical boundary is visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The legs of the figure on the far left appear to merge indistinctly with the wooden ramp and shadows. The anatomy is vague, lacking clear definition of feet or separation from the floor, suggesting slight melting or generation ambiguity.
The wood grain on the ramp is somewhat repetitive and lacks the random variation of real wood. The edges of the planks are slightly soft rather than sharp.
The raised hand of the central figure and the hands of the figure on the right lack distinct finger definition, appearing as smooth, mitten-like shapes typical of AI silhouette generation issues.

To verify the 3D consistency of the ramp leading to the stage and ensure the figures are grounded on the same plane.
